reviewMethod: Read-only: anon storage sign + local frame extraction (ffmpeg). No new provider calls.

subject.prompt: Change his shirt to a navy track jacket with white side stripes. Keep everything else identical.

labels.downscale: OBSERVED — expected 720p edits cap per recap spec

axes.name: Identity preservation (face, beard, glasses)
axes.label: OBSERVED
axes.note: Same subject across frames; beard and glasses consistent vs source t≈2.235s.

axes.name: Body geometry / proportions
axes.label: OBSERVED
axes.note: Torso/limb proportions stable; no obvious morphing.

axes.name: Pose fidelity
axes.label: OBSERVED
axes.note: Arms-crossed / forward-lean poses match source benchmark moments.

axes.name: Performance motion continuity
axes.label: OBSERVED
axes.note: Motion reads continuous over ~3.7s; minor hand/mouth blur at mid-clip.

axes.name: Camera framing / motion
axes.label: OBSERVED
axes.note: Locked-off medium shot; framing matches source closet setup.

axes.name: Background preservation
axes.label: VERIFIED
axes.note: White door, open closet, red-laced boots, black hanger garment with white graphic all preserved vs source.

axes.name: Lighting / shadows continuity
axes.label: OBSERVED
axes.note: Indoor lighting consistent; no scene relight.

axes.name: Garment swap accuracy (navy track jacket + white sleeve stripes)
axes.label: OBSERVED
axes.note: Camo shirt replaced with navy zip track jacket and prominent white sleeve stripes in direction of prompt + refs. Collar/zip/rib detail approximate, not product-pinned.

axes.name: Logo / typography
axes.label: OBSERVED
axes.note: Chest logo area not legible; cannot verify SAINT LAURENT placement at 720p.

axes.name: Temporal consistency (flicker, morphing, swimming)
axes.label: OBSERVED
axes.note: No full-scene boiling; mild sleeve-stripe edge softness/shimmer on some frames.

axes.name: Edit vs regenerate
axes.label: VERIFIED
axes.note: MAJOR FAILURE: **no**. Scene/person/background preserved; garment region changed — behaves as edit, not full regen.

verdict.apiLevel: VERIFIED — combined video + reference_images accepted (prior artifact)
verdict.visualLevel: OBSERVED — partial pass: edit character strong; garment micro-detail/logo weak
verdict.architectureC: RECOMMENDATION — viable research path; not production-certified without scored Tests A/B and logo/stripe audit at golden frames

limitations: Single terse prompt probe — not A1/A2 long-prompt runs
Garment product refs not side-by-side pixel-audited in this pass (storage sign 404 on ref paths via anon)
720p output caps stripe/logo legibility per frozen recap spec
